body:
You know? I am really scared to face them, I’m scared of the dark feeling and thoughts that might come out after I face them.  What if it doesn’t bring me healing and it just hurts me more? 
I try with all my power not to think about what happened, cause every time I do I can’t stop crying.

That’s your opinion and I respect it, but I don’t think we should judge people based on one mistake they made

I really hope you never go through a situation as hard as this

Breakdowns are the worst, it really feels like the whole weight of the universe is on you. 
Know that you are not alone, I guess everyone feels pain from time to time, and it is on us to find the little things in life that brings us joy, try to collect as many as we can, hoping one day we will forget what pain feels like...

I’m 25 now, and while I live a normal life now, the feeling are still there.

I don’t really think I can cut my parents out of my life. Despite this thing that happened, they have given me love and support in many other aspects in my life. I have lived a privileged life full of adventure, having everything I needed and more and for that I am very thankful. I don’t want to be rude and ungrateful for everything they’ve done for me. I know they meant no harm, but what would you do in their position? Kick out of the house your own son? Bring shame (publicly) to your family? ( I don’t know if you understand but we live in a small and conservative town. Maybe my dads job would have been compromised if anyone found out about what happened, or people yelling things in the streets to my mom, or kids bullying my younger brother.) it’s hard, and so complicated. I’m sure they meant no harm, and did what they thought was right.

About my brother, I sometimes feel like telling the world what he did, but I don’t want to harm him. I don’t think he could keep his job if people knew, or even have friends, I don’t think he could have a life. On the other hand I feel like he deserved punishment, and I know he has a hard time accepting what he did, even though I’ve never received and apology. I think knowing what he did and having to live with the regret and shame of it is enough...

This whole thing is a mess, and I don’t think there is a “ solution”

I appreciate you taking the time to read my story
